Boosey & Hawkes, Bärenreiter and Peters sites are JavaScript-driven and could not be read, so Chin, Pintscher, Neuwirth and Saunders rest on IRCAM/Wikipedia plus two web searches. Zimmermann Concerto (1950) and Kleine Suite come only from the Schott person page and German Wikipedia (durations unknown). Hekton (Rihm), Whispers/Breath/Taste (Saunders) and Hartmann 2. Sonate not confirmed as published. Furrer: only Lied found. Stockhausen and Lachenmann checked lightly.
